entities.name: Query PPi-PFK
observations: 435 aa protein with a PFK domain spanning residues 24–339; predicted molecular mass 47.2 kDa and basic pI 9.34.
Matches reviewed pyrophosphate--fructose 6-phosphate 1-phosphotransferases at 62.9–71.8% identity over approximately 94–95% query coverage.
Sequence-based identification is strongly supported by homology, but the exact substrate reaction remains an annotation transfer from close homologs rather than a direct assay of this sequence.

entities.name: Pyrophosphate--fructose 6-phosphate 1-phosphotransferase
observations: Reviewed homologs Q609I3, E1VB09, and B0RP51 are annotated with EC 2.7.1.90 and Rhea RHEA:13613.
Catalyzes reversible phosphorylation of D-fructose 6-phosphate using inorganic diphosphate (PPi), producing fructose 1,6-bisphosphate and phosphate.
Reported cofactors include Mg2+, with Co2+ and Mn2+ also supported for some homologs; homologs are cytosolic homodimers.
The PPi-dependent reaction can support both glycolytic and gluconeogenic directions.
